obs.craftax_frame: obs[:63, :63] is Craftax's 63x63 agent frame; the last row and column are black padding (the harnesses fix the observation at 64)

human.controls: Arrows move and face. SPACE interacts. TAB sleeps. 1-4 place stone/table/furnace/sapling. 5-7 craft pickaxes, 8-9-0 craft swords (stand next to a table; iron needs a furnace too).

reference.name: PufferLib craftax_classic
reference.parity: full-state trace, every step, scalar no-FMA build, libm bound to V8 ieee754
not_matched: the host reset consumes one NOOP step before the first agent action (PlayTrain draws and steps in the same frame), so a PlayTrain episode is the C episode with a NOOP prepended

Craftax-Classic-Pixels below light_level 0.5, as drawn by the hosts: Craftax adds per-pixel static from state_rng, which its step derives from the DRIVER's PRNGKey and the step index (a fixed number of splits; independent of actions and world). Given that driver seed the game derives state_rng itself (setDriverSeed; threefry-2x32 + split in 16_threefry.js) and the frame is byte-identical at every light level: 147/147 daylight + 74/74 night frames (seed 11, driver seed 7) and 120/120 (seed 3, driver seed 2024, death frame included). Craftax needs the same driver seed, so this is the same interface. No host passes one yet, so what the hosts draw at night is the deterministic dusk image without the static; at light_level >= 0.5 the hosts' frame IS byte-identical to render_craftax_pixels(state).astype(uint8). See reference/craftax_pixels/README.md
